mapper.select: SELECT v.`id`, v.`shop_id`, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, v.`status`, sv.`stock` , sv.begin_time , sv.end_time, p.valid_days,p.valid_until,p.min_spend,p.refund_allowed,COALESCE(p.ready,1) ready FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id LEFT JOIN tb_voucher_policy p ON p.voucher_id=v.id LEFT JOIN tb_shop_settings st ON st.shop_id=v.shop_id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND v.type IN (0, 1) AND v.status = 1 AND COALESCE(st.status,1)=1 ORDER BY v.type DESC, v.id ASC
